source.helpFrame: Drag the box to set the frame at this point. Arrows move it 1%, Shift+arrows 10%. Esc goes back.
source.helpSplit: Drag a box to move it, pull a corner to resize. Plus and minus zoom. Esc goes back.

transcript.cleanupHint: Fillers, repeats and long pauses you can cut

lines.help: Type to fix a word. Its timing stays right.
lines.captionsOff: Captions are off. Turn them on in the Text tab.
lines.captionsOffCard: Captions are off. Turn them on in the Caption card.
lines.loadError: Caption lines could not load yet; the editor is retrying.
lines.empty: No word shows in the caption. Hidden words can be shown again in the transcript.
lines.hiddenDetail: {count, plural, one {# word in this line is hidden from the caption; its sound stays. Type it again to show it.} other {# words in this line are hidden from the caption; their sound stays. Type them again to show them.}}

shortcuts.singleKeyHelp: K, I, O, ' and ? work without Ctrl. Turn them off if you press them by accident. Applies to the dashboard too.

captions.note: Clips whose caption was changed by hand are left out.
captions.title: Apply this caption to all clips?

layout.note: Manual framing is not copied. Clips whose layout was changed by hand are left out.
layout.title: Apply this layout to all clips?

logo.note: Logo and text watermark. Clips changed by hand are left out.
logo.title: Apply this logo to all clips?

caption.title: Caption
caption.highlightGlow: The word being spoken and its glow.
caption.highlightOff: Used by Karaoke, Bold, Highlight and Glow; it does not show in this style.
caption.zoneAtSeed: The default spot, near the TikTok buttons. If they cover it, move the caption up.
caption.zoneMoved: The caption is in the TikTok/Reels button area; move it up if they cover it.
caption.hookNear: The caption is close to the hook. If they overlap in the preview, move the caption down.
caption.overFace: The caption covers the speaker's face.
caption.overFaceNoFix: The caption covers the speaker's face. Move it or make it smaller.
caption.emphasisNote: Mark keywords in the transcript (select a word, Ctrl+E).

packs.boldNote: Heavy, the active word in colour
packs.sorotNote: A colour box on the spoken word

hook.title: Hook
hook.overflowNote: The hook does not fit 3 lines; its end becomes “…”. Shorten the text.
hook.glyphs: The hook font lacks {glyphs}; these characters will not show in the video.
hook.unsafe: The hook is in the top area the app's interface covers.

designs.barNote: White text on a dark bar
designs.kickerNote: A small line above large text
designs.kickerHint: Small line: the words up to the first punctuation mark. Without one, the first 1–3 words.
designs.blokNote: Each line in a yellow box
designs.kotakNote: One word in a yellow box
designs.kotakHint: A word in capitals goes in the box. Without one, the longest word.

layout.title: Video layout
layout.bars: Black bars at the source's edges are left out.
layout.zoomNote: Enlarge up to {percent}%. The picture's edges are cut.

modes.fitBlurNote: The whole picture shows. Top and bottom are filled with a blurred copy of it.
modes.cameraNote: A {ratio} crop moves with the face. Needs one face analysis per clip; parts without a face show on a blurred background.
modes.cameraCentredNote: A {ratio} crop moves with the face. Needs one face analysis per clip; parts without a face are centred.
modes.fillCenterNote: A {ratio} crop stays at the picture's centre. Left and right are cut.
modes.splitNote: Two crops of the same video, stacked with a thin line between them.

analysis.label: Face analysis
analysis.switchAfter: The layout changes when the analysis ends. Choose another one to cancel.

noFace.title: Parts without a face
noFace.none: A face was found in the whole clip.
noFace.runs: {count, plural, one {# part without a face.} other {# parts without a face.}}
noFace.blurNote: These parts show the whole picture on a blurred background.

framing.title: Frame
framing.autoCamera: Auto: the frame follows the face.
framing.manual: {count, plural, one {Set by hand: # point.} other {Set by hand: # points.}}
framing.manualCamera: {count, plural, one {Set by hand: # point, also in parts without a face.} other {Set by hand: # points, also in parts without a face.}}
framing.portrait: The source is already upright; there is nothing to move.

keyframe.title: Frame points
keyframe.notHere: {count, plural, one {# point. None at this position.} other {# points. None at this position.}}
keyframe.moveNote: Cut jumps exactly at this point; Slide moves slowly from the previous point.
keyframe.moveNoteFirst: Choose the second point or a later one to set its move.

music.title: Background music
music.empty: No music yet. MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG or FLAC, up to 50 MB and 15 minutes.
music.uploadsOff: File uploads are off on this server.
music.volumeNote: Starts from the track's loudness, so it does not cover the voice.
music.shorter: The music is shorter than the clip, so its end has none. Turn on Loop in Advanced to fill it.

notice.title: Use music you may use
notice.text: Copyrighted songs can get a video muted or blocked by the copyright checks of TikTok, Instagram and YouTube (Content ID).

fine.attackNote: The music starts falling before the first word.
fine.holdNote: Pauses shorter than this do not bring the music back up.

source.title: Original sound
source.suggest: Suggested with music, so the volume holds across clips.

logo.title: Logo
logo.empty: Shows above the caption for the whole clip. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB. You can also drop a file here.
logo.uploadsOff: Logo uploads are not available on this server.
logo.unsafe: The logo is in the area the TikTok/Reels buttons cover.
logo.dragHelp: Drag the logo in the preview to place it anywhere; Alt turns the magnet off.

watermark.title: Text watermark
watermark.note: One line for the whole clip.
watermark.glyphs: The watermark font lacks {glyphs}; these characters will not show in the video.

coldOpen.title: Cold open
coldOpen.pickFirst: Select a sentence in the transcript first.
coldOpen.note: A short piece (0.5–8 s) that plays first; then the clip starts from its beginning.

fine.label: Move the cold open's edges by 0.1 s
fine.startEarlier: Start the cold open 0.1 s earlier
fine.startLater: Start the cold open 0.1 s later
fine.endEarlier: End the cold open 0.1 s earlier
fine.endLater: End the cold open 0.1 s later

transition.title: Transition
transition.note: The effect where the cold open joins the clip. The clip's length stays.
transition.off: Turn on the cold open first.
